_comment: Applications whose FDA goal date has passed with no public decision. Hand-verified: each entry was checked against the sponsor's own releases and the FDA's surfaces at write time, and carries the primary source the note comes from. Saying 'the FDA has not decided' is a claim, so it is sourced like every other claim here. Remove an entry once a decision is published; the decided-banner injector then owns the page. Audit 2026-09-06 NEW-2.

passed.status_note: KETAFREE is an abbreviated new drug application, so its target is a GDUFA goal date rather than a PDUFA date. Per NRx's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q and its August 17, 2026 release, on July 30, 2026 the FDA notified the company that its first-round review identified no major deficiencies relating to the drug components of the product but a major deficiency relating to the container closure system; the company said it has provided the manufacturer's attestation on the vial's Luer-lock tip. A first-cycle deficiency letter is not an approval.
passed.first_cycle_text: the FDA completed its first-cycle review, identifying no major deficiencies relating to the drug components and one major deficiency relating to the container closure system (the vial's Luer-lock tip); NRx says it has submitted the requested manufacturer's attestation and targets approval in 2026.
